limitations: No export records, native RPUIDs, query outputs or full-reader validation yet; documentation and search snippets do not establish P04 query coverage.

Owned codeG is federal fee-simple interest; leasedL,other-governmentS/F,tribalT,museumM,withdrawnW are distinct. Restrict any future sample to government-ownedG; exclude owner/lessor persons,addresses,coordinates,contacts and full-property text.
Annual September30 snapshot is not current title proof; public extract excludes FOIA/national-security records. Missing values may be not-applicable orredacted.
